changes.oldValue: Segment J3 aligns with C3 as the unit-average computation step but averages the raw unit prices (cost1 + cost2) / 2 instead of dividing the weighted extended total (ext1 + ext2) by totQty. Whenever QTY-1 != QTY-2 and COST-1 != COST-2 (as in T5: 15.00 vs 16.67, and T6: 10.01 vs 10.02), J3 diverges from COBOL.
changes.value: Segment J3 aligns with C3 as the unit-average computation step but computes the unweighted mean (cost1 + cost2) / 2 instead of the quantity-weighted mean (ext1 + ext2) / totQty. This can change the rounded output: T5 yields Java 15.00 versus COBOL 16.67, and T6 yields Java 10.01 versus COBOL 10.02. Unequal quantities and unequal unit prices do not guarantee different rounded outputs; rounding can mask the formula error, as the audited F004-A4 case (quantities 1 and 2, costs 10.00 and 10.01) produces 10.01 in both programs.
